sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Importing data types
sections.what: Brings in the type definitions for every kind of item and setting the app stores.
sections.why: Likely reason: the default values must match the shapes the app expects.

sections.name: initialUserProfile, initialProjects, initialTasks, initialHabits, initialRoutines
sections.title: Default user profile and empty lists
sections.what: Sets the default profile for a new user, including level, experience, coins, streak and enabled modules. Also exports empty lists for projects, tasks, habits, routines, notes, courses, assignments, and other item types.
sections.why: Likely reason: a new user starts with nothing filled in, and the profile holds the defaults for progress and labels.
sections.watch_out: The last active date is taken when the file loads, so a long running session keeps the old date.

sections.name: initialSettings
sections.title: Default app settings
sections.what: Sets the starting preferences: dark theme, sound and notifications on, a daily focus goal of 100 minutes, five daily tasks, and automatic backup on.
sections.why: Likely reason: sensible starting preferences that the user can change later.
sections.watch_out: These defaults are shared by every new user, so a change here affects all new accounts.

summary: Holds the starting values for a new user: a blank profile, default settings, and empty lists for every kind of item.
purpose: Give the app a known clean starting state and default preferences.
why: Likely reason: a fresh start needs known values. Reason not stated beyond that.
how: 1. Defines the default user profile, with level 1, zero coins, two freeze tokens, default modules and custom labels. 2. Exports empty lists for projects, tasks, habits, goals and other item types. 3. Defines default settings such as dark theme, a 100 minute focus goal, five daily tasks, and automatic backup on.
inputs: None. These are fixed values, except the profile's last active date, which is set when the file loads.
outputs: Starting values used when the app creates or resets data.
risks: The last active date is set when the file loads, so it can be out of date in a long session. Nothing checks these defaults beyond the type definitions at build time.
debug: If a new user sees odd starting values, check this file first. If a label is wrong on a screen, compare the custom labels here with the persona helper.
